verdict.rationale: skills.sh is built around the SKILL.md format defined by the open Agent Skills specification at agentskills.io, which requires YAML frontmatter plus Markdown and offers a `skills-ref validate` tool. The spec explicitly promises building a skill once and reusing it across any skills-compatible agent. The CLI scaffolds SKILL.md templates and installs the same skill folder into 75+ agents, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode, so one folder works beyond a single vendor's tooling. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that `skills init` templates and installed skills are validated against the spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the same folder works unchanged across non-Vercel agents.
